raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 4996 rows but only 4975 distinct txn_id values, so 21 rows are repeat deliveries of transactions already sent in another batch. silver_transactions does not deduplicate, so 17 POSTED txn_ids appear more than once and are double-counted in every gold table. The fix keeps the most recently ingested record per txn_id and then applies the POSTED filter. I could not see the duplicate rows themselves, so if they turn out to be conflicting versions rather than plain re-sends, this assumption needs checking.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
